verdict.rationale: Calendly documents a REST API v2 that can programmatically book meetings and read and write Scheduling, Contacts, and Notetaker data. It also supports creating event types (POST /event_types, exposed as an MCP tool), reading availability, and webhooks for scheduling events. However, nothing in the evidence claims UI parity. Many UI features have no API evidence: routing forms, Workflows automations, payments, polls, team admin controls and Callie. missing for 10: any documented UI/API parity claim, API coverage for routing forms, workflows, payments, polls and admin settings, independent or hands-on confirmation of API breadth.
